blocks.en_text: Welcome to Real Easy English from  BBC Learning English. I'm Beth.
blocks.zh_text: 欢迎收听BBC Learning English的Real Easy English。我是Beth。

blocks.en_text: And I'm Neil. In this podcast, we have  a real conversation in easy English.
blocks.zh_text: 我是Neil。在这档播客里，我们用简单的英语进行真实的对话。

blocks.en_text: If you want to read along, you can visit  our website. BBC Learning English dot com.
blocks.zh_text: 如果你想边听边看，可以访问我们的网站。BBC Learning English点com。

blocks.en_text: — Hi, Neil. — Hi, Beth. How are you?
blocks.zh_text: ——嗨，Neil。——嗨，Beth。你好吗？

blocks.en_text: I'm very good, thank you. How are you?
blocks.zh_text: 我很好，谢谢。你好吗？

blocks.en_text: — I'm pretty good, yes. — Good, good.
blocks.zh_text: ——我挺好的，是的。——好，好。

blocks.en_text: What are we talking about today?
blocks.zh_text: 我们今天聊什么？

blocks.en_text: Well, today we are talking about food.
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，今天我们聊食物。

blocks.en_text: In particular, we'll talk about our favourite foods
blocks.zh_text: 特别是，我们会聊聊我们最喜欢的食物

blocks.en_text: and how often we eat them.
blocks.zh_text: 以及我们多久吃一次。

blocks.en_text: What an amazing topic. I have so much to say about food.
blocks.zh_text: 多棒的话题啊。关于食物我可有太多要说的了。

blocks.en_text: But you said how often.
blocks.zh_text: 但你说了“多久一次”。

blocks.en_text: What do we mean by how often we eat something?
blocks.zh_text: “我们多久吃一次某样东西”是什么意思呢？

blocks.en_text: Mm, good question!
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，好问题！

blocks.en_text: 'How often' means 'how many times' we eat our favourite food.
blocks.zh_text: “多久一次”意思是我们吃最喜欢的食物的“次数”。

blocks.en_text: So we might eat them every week, every day, or if we really like a food,
blocks.zh_text: 所以我们可能每周吃、每天吃，或者如果我们真的很喜欢某种食物，

blocks.en_text: we might eat it for breakfast, lunch and dinner — every meal!
blocks.zh_text: 我们可能早餐、午餐、晚餐都吃——每顿都吃！

blocks.en_text: So, Neil, what is your favourite food?
blocks.zh_text: 那么，Neil，你最喜欢的食物是什么？

blocks.en_text: Well, that's a really difficult question,
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，这真是个很难的问题，

blocks.en_text: but I really like fish.
blocks.zh_text: 但我真的很喜欢鱼。

blocks.en_text: Ah, me too!
blocks.zh_text: 啊，我也是！

blocks.en_text: I was gonna say that, but actually, I really love seafood.
blocks.zh_text: 我正想说这个，但其实，我真的很喜欢海鲜。

blocks.en_text: So, I think I’d say any kind of dish with seafood in it,
blocks.zh_text: 所以，我想我会说任何带海鲜的菜，

blocks.en_text: I absolutely love.
blocks.zh_text: 我都超级喜欢。

blocks.en_text: So, how often do you eat seafood, Beth?
blocks.zh_text: 那么，Beth，你多久吃一次海鲜？

blocks.en_text: Well, not very often, actually.
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，其实不常吃。

blocks.en_text: I have it when I go on holiday and I have it in restaurants sometimes,
blocks.zh_text: 我度假的时候会吃，有时候在餐厅也会吃，

blocks.en_text: but I don't really cook seafood at home.
blocks.zh_text: 但我在家不太做海鲜。

blocks.en_text: What about you? How often do you have fish?
blocks.zh_text: 你呢？你多久吃一次鱼？

blocks.en_text: Oh, probably a few times a week.
blocks.zh_text: 哦，大概一周几次吧。

blocks.en_text: — Really? — Maybe, yeah.
blocks.zh_text: ——真的吗？——也许吧，是的。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. We eat a lot of fish.
blocks.zh_text: 是的。我们吃很多鱼。

blocks.en_text: We sometimes have fish at home. I normally have it once or twice a week.
blocks.zh_text: 我们有时候在家吃鱼。我通常一周吃一两次。

blocks.en_text: Right.
blocks.zh_text: 好的。

blocks.en_text: But I never have seafood at home, actually.
blocks.zh_text: 但其实我在家从来不买海鲜吃。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, OK. So what is your least favourite food?
blocks.zh_text: 好，明白了。那你最不喜欢的食物是什么？

blocks.en_text: Ooh, I absolutely hate baked beans!
blocks.zh_text: 哦，我超级讨厌茄汁焗豆！

blocks.en_text: You hate baked beans!?
blocks.zh_text: 你讨厌茄汁焗豆！？

blocks.en_text: I think they're disgusting!
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得它们很恶心！

blocks.en_text: I can't even...
blocks.zh_text: 我甚至都……

blocks.en_text: The smell of them even makes me feel a bit sick.
blocks.zh_text: 光是它们的味道就让我有点想吐。

blocks.en_text: Oh, OK.
blocks.zh_text: 哦，好吧。

blocks.en_text: So we've talked about the foods that we really like
blocks.zh_text: 所以我们聊了我们真正喜欢的食物

blocks.en_text: and the foods that we don't like.
blocks.zh_text: 和我们不喜欢的食物。

blocks.en_text: But in a general week, what do you normally cook?
blocks.zh_text: 但在平常的一周里，你通常做什么菜？

blocks.en_text: Often, we'll eat Indian curries,
blocks.zh_text: 我们经常吃印度咖喱，

blocks.en_text: but also Italian pasta dishes or Spanish dishes
blocks.zh_text: 不过也吃意大利面食或西班牙菜

blocks.en_text: and then sometimes more traditional British roast dinner kind of thing.
blocks.zh_text: 然后有时候还会吃那种更传统的英式烤肉晚餐之类的。

blocks.en_text: Yeah.
blocks.zh_text: 对。

blocks.en_text: I think, generally, we have the same at home.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得，一般来说，我们在家吃的都差不多。

blocks.en_text: Like, we eat a lot of food from different countries.
blocks.zh_text: 比如，我们会吃很多来自不同国家的食物。

blocks.en_text: But I have to say I usually cook quite a lot of pasta
blocks.zh_text: 但我得说，我平时经常做很多意面，

blocks.en_text: and quite a lot of rice at home in general,
blocks.zh_text: 而且总的来说，在家也经常做很多米饭，

blocks.en_text: just because they cook really quickly!
blocks.zh_text: 就是因为它们做起来特别快！

blocks.en_text: So, Beth. You generally eat rice and pasta dishes.
blocks.zh_text: 那么，Beth。你一般吃米饭和意面类的菜。

blocks.en_text: What does that mean, 'generally'?
blocks.zh_text: “generally”是什么意思呢？

blocks.en_text: Well, we use 'generally' and 'usually' and 'normally'
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，我们用“generally”、“usually”和“normally”

blocks.en_text: for habits or things that we do a lot.
blocks.zh_text: 来表示习惯或者我们经常做的事情。

blocks.en_text: So, for example, if I generally cook pasta or rice,
blocks.zh_text: 比如说，如果我一般做意面或米饭，

blocks.en_text: that means maybe five times out of the seven in a week, I would say.
blocks.zh_text: 那意思就是，一周七天里大概有五天我会这么做。

blocks.en_text: OK, so that’s most of the time.
blocks.zh_text: 好，那就是大部分时间。

blocks.en_text: If we use 'sometimes' we mean that we'd do it less than 'generally'.
blocks.zh_text: 如果我们用“sometimes”，意思是做的频率比“generally”低。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, sometimes might be two or three times a week.
blocks.zh_text: 对，sometimes可能是一周两三次。

blocks.en_text: I guess it depends on what you're talking about.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得这得看你说的是什么。

blocks.en_text: But for example, with me, I sometimes cook fish.
blocks.zh_text: 但比如说，我有时候会做鱼。

blocks.en_text: Like I said I have it maybe twice a week.
blocks.zh_text: 就像我说的，我大概一周吃两次。

blocks.en_text: So I would say that’s sometimes.
blocks.zh_text: 所以我会说那算是sometimes。

blocks.en_text: Beth, you said that you hate baked beans.
blocks.zh_text: Beth，你说过你讨厌茄汁焗豆。

blocks.en_text: So do you ever eat baked beans?
blocks.zh_text: 那你到底吃不吃茄汁焗豆呢？

blocks.en_text: Never. No, I can't stand them.
blocks.zh_text: 从不。不吃，我受不了那个。

blocks.en_text: So I never, ever have baked beans.
blocks.zh_text: 所以我从来、从来不吃茄汁焗豆。

blocks.en_text: Well, 'never' is something that we don't do.
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，“never”就是我们不做的事情。

blocks.en_text: We just don't ever do it.
blocks.zh_text: 我们就是从来都不做。

blocks.en_text: I can’t believe you don't like baked beans.
blocks.zh_text: 我真不敢相信你不喜欢茄汁焗豆。

blocks.en_text: Beans on toast is a classic!
blocks.zh_text: 茄汁焗豆配吐司可是经典！

blocks.en_text: It is. But, no. Not for me.
blocks.zh_text: 确实是。但是，不。不适合我。

blocks.en_text: Let's quickly recap the vocabulary we learnt during the conversation.
blocks.zh_text: 我们快速回顾一下对话中学到的词汇。

blocks.en_text: We learnt 'often' which means 'we do something a lot'.
blocks.zh_text: 我们学了“often”，意思是“我们经常做某事”。

blocks.en_text: And we learnt 'how often',
blocks.zh_text: 我们还学了“how often”，

blocks.en_text: which we use to ask someone 'how many times they do something'.
blocks.zh_text: 用来问别人“他们做某事的频率有多高”。

blocks.en_text: 'Usually', 'normally', and 'generally',
blocks.zh_text: “usually”、“normally”和“generally”，

blocks.en_text: which are all ways to talk about 'things we do a lot'.
blocks.zh_text: 这些都是谈论“我们经常做的事情”的方式。

blocks.en_text: 'Sometimes', which we can use
blocks.zh_text: “sometimes”，我们可以用它

blocks.en_text: to talk about 'things we do, but not always or often'.
blocks.zh_text: 来谈论“我们会做、但不是总是或经常做的事情”。

blocks.en_text: And 'never' to talk about 'things we don't do', like eat beans, Beth.
blocks.zh_text: 还有“never”，用来谈论“我们不做的事情”，比如吃豆子，Beth。

blocks.en_text: Yes, just like I never eat baked beans. Urgh, horrible!
blocks.zh_text: 对，就像我从不吃茄汁焗豆。呃，太难吃了！

blocks.en_text: Thanks for listening to Real Easy  English. Visit our website for
blocks.zh_text: 感谢收听Real Easy English。访问我们的网站，获取

blocks.en_text: more activities and courses to help you with  your English. BBC Learning English dot com.
blocks.zh_text: 更多活动和课程，帮助你提高英语。BBC Learning English点com。

blocks.en_text: Next week, we'll talk about our friends.
blocks.zh_text: 下周，我们会聊聊我们的朋友。

blocks.en_text: See you then. Goodbye!
blocks.zh_text: 到时候见。再见！

blocks.en_text: Bye!
blocks.zh_text: 再见！
